mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate environment consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as discount rates compress.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve initiates aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as market participants price in reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from their 3-month moving averages signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from their 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), labor market weakness directly reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face sustained downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate production and earnings face immediate headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a significant slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as broader economic weakness spreads to consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 450,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000.
